body_markdown:
**Eatontown, New Jersey (November 18, 2026)** – A strong MSP technology stack is about more than protecting endpoints and managing infrastructure. It also helps customers reduce human risk, understand their technology investments, and operate more efficiently.


Breach Secure Now helps MSPs deliver cybersecurity awareness, phishing simulations, AI education, Microsoft 365 productivity training, and compliance-focused services. BetterTracker helps MSPs improve visibility into software, subscriptions, contracts, renewals, and technology spending.


### **Vendor Spotlight #1: Breach Secure Now**


#### **Turn Employee Education into an Ongoing Managed Service**


Employees are frequent targets of phishing, social engineering, and credential theft. Breach Secure Now gives MSPs a way to offer ongoing training and reinforcement as part of their managed service portfolio.


#### **Key Capabilities**


- **Cybersecurity awareness training:** Recurring education about phishing, ransomware, passwords, and safer online habits
- **Phishing simulations:** Exercises that test readiness and reinforce lessons
- **Dark web monitoring:** Visibility into exposed credentials for proactive security discussions
- **AI awareness and adoption:** Education on responsible, productive generative AI use
- **Microsoft 365 productivity training:** Practical instruction to help employees use existing tools
- **Compliance enablement:** Training, risk assessments, and policy templates supporting requirements such as HIPAA and OSHA


#### **Why MSPs Should Care**


MSPs can package employee training as a recurring service, helping clients strengthen security awareness, support compliance initiatives, and demonstrate progress over time.


#### **Ideal Customers**


SMBs without dedicated security teams; healthcare, legal, financial, and other compliance-sensitive organizations; businesses concerned about phishing; and teams adopting AI or Microsoft 365.


#### **Conversation Starter**


“How are your customers training employees to recognize cyber threats, and how do they measure whether that training works?”


#### **Line-Card One-Liner**


MSP-focused employee training for cybersecurity awareness, phishing simulations, AI education, Microsoft 365 productivity, and compliance enablement.


Learn more:[https://breachsecurenow.com/](https://breachsecurenow.com/)


### **Vendor Spotlight #2: BetterTracker**


#### **Gain Visibility, Reduce Software Waste, and Strengthen Customer Relationships**


As organizations add cloud applications and subscriptions, it becomes harder to track software spend, contracts, licenses, and renewals. BetterTracker helps MSPs centralize that visibility and identify optimization opportunities.


#### **Key Capabilities**


- **Software discovery:** Identify applications and subscriptions across customer environments
- **Spend visibility:** Spot recurring expenses and potential overlapping costs
- **Contract and renewal tracking:** Organize agreements, renewal dates, and notice periods
- **License optimization:** Surface unused licenses and consolidation opportunities
- **Technology stack visibility:** Understand application ownership and overlap
- **AI-powered recommendations:** Use Betty AI to surface potential savings and optimization priorities
- **Multi-customer management:** Manage software information across client environments


#### **Why MSPs Should Care**


BetterTracker helps MSPs become strategic technology advisors. Software and spend insights can support QBRs, identify savings opportunities, and improve conversations about client technology decisions and profitability.


#### **Ideal Customers**


MSPs managing multiple software-heavy clients; organizations with growing SaaS spending; teams struggling with renewals and unused licenses; and customers focused on cost optimization.


#### **Conversation Starter**


“Do your customers know what they spend on software each month—and which licenses they actually use?”


#### **Line-Card One-Liner**


Software intelligence and spend management for application discovery, contract and renewal tracking, license optimization, and technology visibility.


Learn more:[https://bettertracker.com/](https://bettertracker.com/)

Both vendors help MSPs deliver value beyond traditional IT management. Breach Secure Now strengthens the human side of security; BetterTracker strengthens the business side of technology management. Each can support deeper customer relationships and more strategic business reviews.
